readout_other: Morris water maze; novel object recognition; Y-maze; Abeta immunofluorescence; RNA sequencing; western blotting; electron microscopy; H&E
direction_notes: No neural activity readout; FUS reduced Abeta deposition, improved cognition and enhanced autophagosome-lysosome fusion in 5xFAD mice; chloroquine blocked these benefits.
safety_notes: H&E staining showed no morphological abnormality or haemorrhage in FUS-treated 5xFAD brains.

timing.protocol_description: Pulse interval 5 s, sonication duration 200 ms, pulse repetition period 4 ms, pulse duration 2 ms; bilateral stimulation 10 min/day each side for 1 month under 2% isoflurane.

source_quotes.n_subjects: 1(A), four-month-old male mice were allocated into the following groups: WT, AD, AD + Sham, AD + FUS (n = 16 per group), and $\mathrm { A D } \ + \ \mathrm { F U S } \ + \ \mathrm { C Q } \ ( \mathrm { n } \ = \ 1 1 )$ .

flags.reason: Group sizes given: AD+FUS n=16 and AD+FUS+CQ n=11 (both exposed); abstract also says sixteen FUS mice. Total exposed not stated, so group sizes listed; figure legends show n=4 to 7 per analysis.
Paper gives a pulse repetition period of 4 ms, recorded as 250 Hz (unit conversion).
200 ms is the sonication duration within a 5 s pulse interval; 10 min per side per day for one month.
0.32 MPa called 'intracranial' with 18% transcranial attenuation mentioned, but the paper does not say it was derated, simulated or measured.
Isppa and Ispta given with no domain stated.
Bilateral hippocampus by atlas alignment; the elliptical focal region may also include adjacent tissue.
